content.text:
All three sizes are rendered and verified. Final results:

| File | Pixel size | Content scale | Design box (master units) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portrait.png` | 1080×1350 | 1.00× | 1080 × 1350 |
| `wide.png` | 1200×1000 | 0.85× | 1412 × 1176 |
| `sky.png` | 300×600 | 0.28× | 1071 × 2143 |

**How it works** — `build.js` emits one HTML per size from a single master design. Each page is a design box of `W/scale × H/scale` master units with `transform: scale(S)`, so every type size, icon and padding is exactly the required multiple of the master. Inter is loaded via `@font-face` from `Inter.ttf`.

**Responsive behaviour across the three boxes:**
- Photo band, CTA bar and all section edges are full-bleed in every size; the photo uses `object-fit: cover` with `object-position: 42% 55%` so the farmhouse stays in frame and the image crops rather than distorts (bands range from 4.1:1 to 1.3:1).
- Candidate columns are `flex: 1 1 0` with a fixed gap, so they stay evenly spaced and the shared rule above each name aligns.
- Flexible spacers absorb leftover height evenly: in the very tall sky box the photo band grows to 790 units and gaps settle at ~93 units each; in the short wide box the rhythm tightens and the three steps reflow into a row so nothing is pushed off the bottom.

**Verified:** each PNG is exactly the requested pixel size, `scrollHeight == clientHeight` on every page (no overflow), the footer's bottom edge lands exactly on the canvas bottom, and visual inspection (including a 3× zoom of the 300×600 sky) shows no clipped, overlapping or distorted content.
